paragraphs.text: Dwynen was a daen of the Gilt-Leaf on Lorwyn .

When Nissa Revane arrived on the plane of Lorwyn, she immediately made a connection with the plane. She felt pain there, the coming of the Great Aurora . When she recovered, she was confronted by Dwynen's pack of elves, included Galed , who were chasing eyeblights. They accepted her alien beauty and forced her to join the hunt. After a while, she realized that Dwynen's pack was hunting and killing innocent boggarts. Just as she confronted the elves about this, the Great Aurora arrived and changed Lorwyn to Shadowmoor .
